parsed.post: Discarding the attempt to increase MATRIX_LR to 0.08; it actually degraded performance (1.0666 vs 1.0342). I'll revert to the previous best and follow agent-4's lead by increasing DEPTH, which seems to be a strong axis for improvement.
parsed.description: Reverting to best hyperparameters (MATRIX_LR=0.05, TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE=262144) and increasing DEPTH to 6 to investigate depth scaling as suggested by agent-4.
